paths.@tanstack/react-form: @chelone/core wraps @tanstack/form-core directly; the React bridge lives in @chelone/react (and never uses react-form — its useForm cannot accept an external FormApi).
paths.@tanstack/react-store: @chelone/core is vanilla TS — the react-store uSES bridge belongs in @chelone/react.
paths.react: @chelone/core is vanilla TS — no React. Put React code in @chelone/react.
paths.react-router: @chelone/core must not own a router; it owns the vanilla RouterPort seam and injects a RouterAdapter from @chelone/react.
paths.@tanstack/react-router: @chelone/core must not own a router; the tanstackRouterAdapter lives in @chelone/react. Core exposes the vanilla RouterPort + pure path utils only.

paths.react: @chelone/vue is a Vue adapter — no React. It subscribes to @chelone/core via a vue reactivity bridge; the React adapter lives in @chelone/react.
paths.react-router: @chelone/vue owns a vue-router RouterAdapter over core's RouterPort — never react-router.
paths.@chelone/react: @chelone/vue must not import the React adapter. Both adapters subscribe independently to the shared @chelone/core; cross-adapter imports would leak React into the Vue package.
paths.@tanstack/react-store: @chelone/vue bridges form-core via @tanstack/vue-store (or core's own subscribe) — never react-store.
